title: Mass of false under a probability measure
statement: Let $\mu$ be a probability measure on $\mathrm{Bool}$. The real-valued measure of $\{\mathrm{false}\}$ is one minus the real-valued measure of $\{\mathrm{true}\}$: $\mu(\{\mathrm{false}\})=1-\mu(\{\mathrm{true}\})$.
replaced:
Let $\mu$ be a probability measure on the two-point space $\mathrm{Bool} =
\{\mathrm{true}, \mathrm{false}\}$. Then the mass at $\mathrm{false}$ is one minus the
mass at $\mathrm{true}$:
\[
\mu(\{\mathrm{false}\}) = 1 - \mu(\{\mathrm{true}\}).
\]
